name: dn-single-ava-vs-multi-ava-rdn-invalid
description: permittedSubtrees directoryName is C=US,O=Example (single-AVA RDNs). The leaf adds a second AVA to the matching position so the RDN at that index becomes O=Example+OU=Engineering. RFC 5280 7.1 requires matching RDNs to contain the same number of naming attributes, so the leaf's multi-AVA RDN does not match the constraint's single-AVA RDN and the leaf is outside the permitted subtree.
notes: Mirror of dn-multi-ava-vs-single-ava-rdn-invalid: same structural mismatch, opposite direction.
